final_message:
Fixed. `int_to_roman` in `src/roman.py` had no subtractive pairs, so 4 came out as "IIII" instead of "IV". The same bug broke 9, 40, 90, 400, 900 and 1994.

I added CM, CD, XC, XL, IX and IV to the value table. All 6 tests pass now. I haven't committed anything.

You didn't say what "it" was, so I assumed the failing test was the problem. If you meant something else, tell me.
